programme.title: Wraith
programme.desc: After living in an old mansion for almost 10 years a family suddenly discovers a ghost-like presence trying to communicate with them.

programme.title: Big Ass Spider!
programme.desc: The unlikely heroic duo of a blue-collar exterminator and Latino security guard must save the day when a military major loses control of a giant spider rampaging through the city of Los Angeles.

programme.title: Chronicles of the Ghostly Tribe
programme.desc: A soldier is working in a snowcapped mountain when an explosion reveals bizarre fossils hidden deep in the caverns. What they discover next will change human history forever.

programme.title: St. Agatha
programme.desc: A pregnant con woman on the run seeks refuge in a desolate convent, only to be met with an unsettling and horrendous evil waiting on the other side.

programme.title: Terrifier
programme.desc: After being resurrected by a sinister entity, Art the Clown returns to the timid town of Miles County where he targets a teenage girl and her younger brother on Halloween night.

programme.title: Terrifier 2
programme.desc: After being resurrected by a sinister entity, Art the Clown returns to Miles County where he begins to target a teenage girl and her younger brother on Halloween.

programme.title: The Endless
programme.desc: Acclaimed filmmakers Moorhead and Benson return with this mind-bending thriller that follows two brothers who receive a cryptic video message inspiring them to revisit the UFO death cult they escaped a decade earlier.

programme.title: The Golem
programme.desc: A mystical woman must save her village from invaders, but the entity she conjures to protect them is a far greater evil.

programme.title: The Lingering
programme.desc: When Dawa was a child, he and his mother were tormented by a strange presence in their house causing them to spend a fearful night hiding in the basement. Years later, after his mother’s death, Dawa is forced to return, once again facing the presence that once tortured him as a child. Is it a ghost or is there something more earthly to explain the strange occurrences?

programme.title: The Love Witch
programme.desc: A modern-day witch uses spells and magic to get men to fall in love with her, in a tribute to 1960s Technicolor thrillers.

programme.title: The Sacrament
programme.desc: A mysterious rural utopia quickly becomes evident that this paradise may not be as it seems.

programme.title: The Truth About Emanuel
programme.desc: A troubled young woman becomes obsessed with her mysterious new neighbor, who bears a striking resemblance to the girl's dead mother.

programme.title: The War Between
programme.desc: April 1862, in the Arizona territory. During the opening months of the Civil War, two enemy soldiers must cooperate in order to survive being stranded in the Sonoran Desert.

programme.title: Vanishing on 7th Street
programme.desc: A blackout causes a city's population to vanish. A handful of survivors realize they escape the darkness.

programme.title: V/H/S
programme.desc: A group of misfits acquire a rare tape with terrifying footage and are confronted with a dead body.

programme.title: Violet & Daisy
programme.desc: Two teenage assassins accept what they think will be a quick-and-easy job, until an unexpected target throws them off their plan.

programme.title: Wasteland
programme.desc: Recently released from prison, Harvey Miller reunites with his three best friends to rob and enact revenge on a local drug kingpin.

programme.title: The Villainess
programme.desc: Bloody revenge is at the heart of this stylish action-thriller that doses the classic femme fatale story with a shot of adrenaline as it follows a former assassin who will stop at nothing to cut ties to her past.

programme.title: Don't Blink
programme.desc: Ten people arrive at a secluded mountain resort to find it completely deserted. With no gas for the return trip, the visitors are forced to stay and investigate the mystery surrounding the abandoned lodge.

programme.title: The Eyes of My Mother
programme.desc: A young girl taught to be unfazed by death grows up to be a dangerous woman with very peculiar desires.

programme.title: The Curse of Audrey Earnshaw
programme.desc: A devout community suffering from a plague is torn apart by a beautiful young woman and the forces of witchcraft, black magic, and possession.

programme.title: Olivia
programme.desc: Janis, a child Cello prodigy, has struggled in her adult life with a split personality disorder and has willingly yielded to the control of her husband/therapist who, with the excuse of striving for her cure, has manipulated her all along through medication and psychological torture. He keeps her virtually imprisoned at his home in an isolated island where she spends her life fighting a never-ending battle inside her multiple personalities.

programme.title: She Came Back
programme.desc: The terrifying journey of Charley who, after a near-death experience, is haunted by her relationship with her deceased mother.

programme.title: Secrets
programme.desc: After her mother's passing, Sammy, a resilient single mother, grapples with the looming threat of a breakdown while keeping her mysterious past hidden. Ava, Sammy's daughter, has hidden a desire to uncover the identity of her father, sensing his significant influence on her identity. The journey to bury her grandmother becomes Ava's chance to delve into her origins, but her exploration uncovers more than she intended to reveal.

programme.title: Lilith
programme.desc: A family sequesters themselves in a high-rise apartment after the mysterious death of their daughter Lilith. Haunted by their past, the survivor's lies, deceits and strange behavior will have you asking: who killed Lilith and who will be next?

programme.title: Run Baby Run
programme.desc: Diana, deaf from birth, begins her training in an idyllic rural landscape, until she comes across a mysterious runner. Hidden behind the darkness of the hood of his sweatshirt, the runner and Diana begin a small running competition that degenerates into a desperate battle for survival. Diana will have to use all her resources, wit, and willpower to survive the violent attack of her pursuer.

programme.title: Meek's Cutoff
programme.desc: Settlers traveling through the Oregon desert in 1845 find themselves stranded in harsh conditions.

programme.title: V/H/S 2
programme.desc: Mysterious VHS tapes with horrific contents are found in a missing student's abandoned house.

programme.title: Violet & Daisy
programme.desc: Two teenage assassins accept what they think will be a quick-and-easy job, until an unexpected target throws them off their plan.

programme.title: We Have Always Lived in the Castle
programme.desc: Two sisters live in isolation with their deranged uncle following the deaths of the rest of their family. When a cousin comes to visit, family secrets and scandals unravel. Based on the beloved Shirley Jackson novel.

programme.title: We Need to Talk About Kevin
programme.desc: Eva is mother to the evil Kevin. She contends with her clueless husband and her son's malevolent ways, in this chilling and unforgettable film.

programme.title: The Woman in the Fifth
programme.desc: A college lecturer flees to Paris after a scandal costs him his job. In the City of Light, he meets a widow who might be involved in a series of murders.

programme.title: XX
programme.desc: This all-female horror anthology features four dark tales from four fiercely talented women.

programme.title: A.I.
programme.desc: In the near future, the mysterious arrival of a scientist sets in motion a college professor’s experiment to prove the existence of AI consciousness.

programme.title: Anna
programme.desc: A man with the ability to enter people's memories takes on the case of a brilliant, troubled sixteen-year-old girl to determine whether she is a sociopath or a victim of trauma.

programme.title: Better Watch Out
programme.desc: On a quiet suburban street, a babysitter must defend a twelve-year-old boy from intruders, only to discover it's far from a normal home invasion.

programme.desc: The Surgeon General’s Advisory stated, before the COVID-19 pandemic, mental health challenges were the leading cause of disability and poor life outcomes in young people. The pandemic shutdown further exacerbated the mental challenges, and youth mental health is trending in the wrong direction across the country. Why is this happening? How do parents and schools play a role? Some experts believe young people were never taught how to fend for themselves because they were raised in a bubble by “concierge parents“ who protected them from learning about life and developing resiliency. Twenty-four-year-old Gracelyn says she describes her childhood just that way. She admits she was overprotected in some ways growing up, which she believes led to struggles with anxiety and depression for the past six years. What does she reveal for the first time? Also, parents of teens with mental health struggles talk about their frustrations. This is a life-saving episode you won’t want to miss.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: The conversation about the rise in mental health issues among young people continues. Dr. Phil speaks with 22-year-old Emma, who says she was a cheerleader and “picture-perfect American girl” who appeared happy on the outside but was secretly struggling with severe anxiety and depression, which led her to make a near-fatal decision that changed her life forever. Ross Szabo, the wellness director at Geffen Academy at UCLA, the CEO of the Human Power Project, and co-author with Melanie Hall of Behind Happy Faces: Taking Charge of Your Mental Health, says he has ideas to implement more mental health education in schools. And, Massachusetts's Congressman Seth Moulton shares his latest project: the new 9-8-8 National Suicide Prevention Lifeline. Americans experiencing a mental health crisis or who are concerned about the mental health of a loved one are now able to dial 9-8-8 and get rapid, free, trained and confidential help from a network of 200+ local crisis centers nationwide.

programme.title: Dr. Phil

The coroner ruled his death a suicide -- but Jake’s parents, Mike and Shannon, say it doesn’t add up. They claim there was no investigation into Jake’s death, no evidence collected and no autopsy performed before Jake's death was ruled a suicide -- and they refuse to believe their son would take his own life. Two witnesses, Brittany and Will, adamantly maintain that Jake accidentally shot himself, but Mike and Shannon say their son knew how to handle guns safely and that the evidence doesn’t support that conclusion. Mike takes Dr. Phil cameras to the scene of the shooting to demonstrate why he believes that Jake was shot by someone else in the room. programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: The family of 19-year-old Jake Limberios continues to search for answers surrounding his death in March 2012. Who fired the gunshot that ended his life? Left with so many unanswered questions, Jake’s parents had his body exhumed and autopsied by renowned forensic pathologist Dr. Cyril Wecht, who concluded that Jake’s cause of death wasn’t suicide. Plus, Brittany and Will say they sympathize with Jake’s parents but are tired of being under suspicion and agree to take polygraph tests to prove they’re not hiding any details about Jake’s death. What will the results reveal? And, Mike and Shannon say their marriage has grown strained since their son’s death -- can they learn to come together and find peace after such a painful loss?

programme.desc: Some believe self-censorship is a big problem today, particularly in light of the idea that someone can be "canceled" for their words -- blocked from having a prominent public platform or career for sharing their opinion. programme.title: The Ascent of Civilization - How the Greeks Changed the World
programme.desc: Ancient Greece – the cradle of modern Europe. Around 3000 years ago, the cultural foundations of western civilisation were laid right here, on the shores of the Mediterranean. It’s the birthplace of democracy, where great thinkers forged the beginnings of scientific reasoning, where theatre was turned into mass entertainment, and where the Olympic Games began. Imaginative animation, stunning visuals and an entertaining narrative combine in an extraordinary exploration of Greece and the rise of an ancient super-power that would leave a permanent mark on western society.

programme.title: The Ascent of Civilization - How the Romans Changed the World
programme.desc: The Romans created one of the greatest empires in history, built with the help of an incredible army of professional legionnaires and a well-oiled political machinery. At its height, a few hundred men ruled over a fifth of mankind and an area stretching from Britain to Syria and from Gibraltar to the Euphrates. They undertook some of the most ambitious building projects of their time: endless roads, gigantic bridges and imposing aqueducts formed a complex infrastructure and left a lasting legacy. This film is a revelatory and unique journey into the world of ancient Rome.

programme.title: The Ascent of Civilization - How the Vikings Changed the World
programme.desc: This episode explores the Vikings not as ruthless raiders but as groundbreaking seafarers, traders, and explorers. Master shipbuilders, they forged vast networks of commerce stretching from Europe to Asia and even reached the shores of America centuries before Columbus. By challenging the stereotype of violent marauders, the documentary presents the Vikings as a tolerant and skilled people whose innovations in navigation and trade reshaped medieval exploration and left an enduring mark on global history.

programme.desc: Alambradas de violencia - Enviado a Montana para dar caza a unos ladrones de bancos, un cazarrecompensas le quita la estrella a un sheriff sustituto que no llegó a su destino y se mete en una guerra de ranchos entre granjeros y ganaderos.

programme.title: Un hombre y un colt
programme.desc: Dakota Joe - Un pistolero a sueldo decide no llevar a cabo su trabajo de matar a un médico cuando descubre que está trabajando para los pobres de la revolución.

programme.title: ¡Ay, Jalisco no te rajes!
programme.desc: Western clásico de vaqueros hecho en México.

programme.title: Un colt por 4 cirios
programme.desc: Una banda atraca un cargamento fiscal de oro. Esa noche, durante la celebración, Farley roba el oro, pero es encontrado muerto a la mañana siguiente.

programme.title: El gran McLintock
programme.desc: El rico ranchero G.W. McLintock utiliza su poder e influencia en el territorio para mantener la paz entre los agricultores, ganaderos, acaparadores de tierras, indios y funcionarios corruptos del gobierno.

programme.title: Killer calibre 32
programme.desc: El súper genial Silver elimina uno a uno a los siete miembros de una banda enmascarada. Entre chicas de taberna y partidas de póquer, la acción no para hasta el dramático desenmascaramiento del jefe de la banda malvada.

programme.title: Avanzada del Infierno
programme.desc: Un veterano de la guerra de Corea intenta ayudar al propietario de una mina de un pequeño pueblo, a desarrollar su mina de tungsteno a pesar de los esfuerzos del jefe del pueblo por detenerlo.

programme.title: El sureño
programme.desc: Adaptación de la novela "Sostén el otoño en tu mano" - La vida de la pobre familia Tucker, que trabajaba como taponadora de algodón y decidió conseguir su propio terreno, pero la naturaleza está en su contra.

programme.title: Yo Soy Vuestro Verdugo
programme.desc: Yo Soy Vuestro Verdugo - Sartana es falsamente acusado de robar un banco, y debe encontrar a los verdaderos ladrones y limpiar su nombre.

programme.title: El secreto del capitán O'Hara
programme.desc: Un soldado sometido a consejo de guerra salva un fuerte y al comandante que testificó falsamente contra él de un ataque indio.

programme.title: Odio por odio
programme.desc: Odio por odio - Un ladrón de bancos que se odia a sí mismo forma una incómoda alianza con un ingenioso buscador de oro mexicano para salvar a su familia de un antiguo socio criminal asesino.

programme.title: Pistoleros de Río Grande
programme.desc: Un vagabundo regresa a un pequeño pueblo para vengar el asesinato de su esposa e hija.

programme.title: Texas Lady
programme.desc: Una mujer de cabeza fuerte del Este hereda un periódico en un pequeño pueblo de Texas donde los barones del ganado locales, que controlan la región, quieren quitársela de encima.

programme.title: Abre tu fosa amigo... llega Sábata
programme.desc: Abre tu fosa amigo... llega Sábata - Steve McGowan regresa de la Guerra Civil y descubre que su padre ha sido asesinado por un codicioso terrateniente. McGowan jura vengarse. En el proceso, se enamora de la prometida del terrateniente.

programme.title: Fuerte solitario
programme.desc: Cuando se produce una repentina oleada de asesinatos en la región del Big Bend de Texas, las sospechas recaen inmediatamente sobre un joven vagabundo que acaba de mudarse a la zona.

programme.title: El día de la ira
programme.desc: Un chico de la basura desaliñado se convierte en el alumno de un famoso pistolero.

programme.title: Su nombre gritaba venganza
programme.desc: Un veterano de la Guerra Civil queda amnésico tras recibir un disparo en la cabeza. Cuando regresa a su ciudad natal, descubre que ha sido declarado desertor.

programme.title: Quedó uno Sólo...La Muerte fue Para Todos
programme.desc: Un hombre es acusado falsamente de robo de banco, incitando a su hermano a sacarlo de la prisión.

programme.title: Buffalo Bill en territorio Tomahawk
programme.desc: Buffalo Bill intenta proteger las tierras de los indios de una banda que quiere hacerse con el oro enterrado allí.

programme.title: California
programme.desc: After the Civil War, Michael "California" Random, is released from prison and goes to Missouri with his partner William.

programme.title: The Oil Prince
programme.desc: The Oilprince, a ruthless swindler, sells a bank worthless oil wells and schemes to divert settlers away from Shelly Lake for his own gain. His plans begin to unravel when Winnetou and his blood brother Old Surehand step in to protect the settlers and expose the fraud.

programme.title: Long Live ... Your Death!
programme.desc: A self-proclaimed Russian prince, a Mexican bandit and a radical Irish female journalist team up during the Mexican Revolution to find fortune and notoriety.

programme.title: The Restless Breed
programme.desc: After Mitch Baker’s father is killed by gun-runners, he follows them to Mexico for revenge. In the border town of Mission, Texas, Mitch faces off with gang leader Jim Simmons, determined to take justice into his own hands, despite warnings from the sheriff.

programme.title: Kill the Wicked!
programme.desc: Good Samaritan drifter, Benny Hudson and a stranded woman, Jenny finds themselves being torture; when they accidentally walk into an gang's hideout in a ghost town.

programme.title: $100,000 for Ringo
programme.desc: Stranger Lee Barton rides into Rainbow Valley, mistaken for a man thought dead. As tensions rise with ruthless town boss Tom Cherry—who's after hidden gold and the affections of a local woman—Barton is drawn into violence and revenge. With a sheriff's help, he seeks justice and a new start with a boy who believes he's his father.

programme.title: Kill Johnny Ringo!
programme.desc: Johnny Ringo, a Texas Ranger, tracks down a counterfeiting ring, but the real challenge is a love triangle involving rancher Ray Scott, his sister Christine, saloon singer Annie, and gang boss Jackson. As Ringo tries to stop the counterfeiters, he learns the sheriff, his own partner, is behind it all, complicating the mission.

programme.title: Four Gunmen of the Holy Trinity
programme.desc: Arms trafficking with the Indians on the one hand and acquiring documents concerning the ownership of a goldmine on the other are the principal interests of Quin and Gomez, the highly suspicious guests at Papa Martinez' inn.

programme.title: Where the Bullets Fly
programme.desc: Young adventurer Gipo owns a fifth of a rock marking a gold mine. With the help of the alluring Lulu Belle, he braves deadly dangers to recover the missing pieces and claim the treasure, facing treachery and peril along the way.

programme.title: Man Who Cried for Revenge
programme.desc: Davy Flanagan, a former Union officer who was part of an attempt to break out of a Confederate prison camp during the Civil War and suffered a blow to the head that left him with amnesia. Then a bounty hunter shows up to collect a bounty on his head as a deserter.

programme.title: Trusting Is Good... Shooting Is Better
programme.desc: Three bandits steal $200,000, but betrayal leaves the loot buried with a dying man. Glenn Hilton pursues the money, while the surviving thieves, a scheming banker, and the alluring Liz all try to claim a share. Greed, deceit, and double-crosses spark a chaotic hunt for the cash.

programme.title: Poker with Pistols
programme.desc: After losing everything in a poker game, Lucas takes a risky job delivering a wagon to Chamaco for $5000. But what seems like an easy deal turns into a deadly trap as he crosses paths with ruthless bandits, a corrupt town boss, and a charming saloon girl whose loyalties may not be what they seem.

programme.title: Twice a Judas
programme.desc: After waking up with amnesia in the desert next to a dead man, Luke Barrett begins piecing together his past. A stranger in black reveals that Luke was hired to kill his own brother, Victor Barrett, a wealthy landowner. As Luke seeks the truth, a deadly confrontation looms, and his memory recovery brings both clarity and danger.

programme.title: Wanted
programme.desc: A local sheriff is unjustly accused of murder in a small town and forced to flee.

programme.title: Taste of Killing
programme.desc: Dubious Bounty Killer Hank Fellows tracks bank stage coaches to observe them being robbed.

programme.title: Treasure of Silver Lake
programme.desc: In Arkansas, a stagecoach robbery by Colonel Brinkley’s gang leaves one passenger dead and a treasure map split in two. His son Fred Engel joins Old Shatterhand and Winnetou to hunt the killers and recover the map. Their search leads them to a farm holding the second half—and to a race against Brinkley’s gang for the gold at Silver Lake.

programme.title: Go with God, Gringo
programme.desc: Framed for his brother’s murder by the Cris brothers, Gringo lands in prison with a friend. When the real killers escape and abduct Carmen, he must survive daring adventures to prove his innocence and rescue her.

programme.title: Day of Anger
programme.desc: Bank robbery pulled off by the bank officials, not the usual James gang.

programme.title: The Cold Killer
programme.desc: José Desman kills his employer, former judge Salazar, who had sentenced his father. This story explores revenge and personal justice as the son confronts the man responsible for his family’s tragedy.

programme.title: Requiem for a Gringo
programme.desc: A unique Euro-western with the hero as an astrologist who wears a leopard suit.

programme.title: There's a Noose Waiting for You Trinity!
programme.desc: Trinity is an ex-gunslinger desperately wanting to be forgiven and accepted by his family that he abandoned years earlier. Unfortunately for him, a ruthless bounty hunter is on his trail.

programme.title: A Coffin for the Sheriff
programme.desc: Spaghetti Western icon Anthony Steffen stars as Shenandoah, a mysterious man who joins a ruthless band of highwaymen after overcoming an almost impossible and death-defying initiation.

programme.title: Two Faces of the Dollar
programme.desc: A teacher, a hero, an ex-colonel, and a beautiful woman plan to rob Fort Henderson. Though the heist succeeds, their troubles have only just begun, as greed, betrayal, and danger threaten to unravel their carefully laid plan.

programme.title: Don't Wait, Django... Shoot!
programme.desc: Django returns home to discover that his father has been killed by local bandits in a business deal gone wrong.

programme.title: Rattler Kid
programme.desc: Falsely convicted for robbing an army treasury, Tony Garrett escapes prison and sets out to find the real criminals responsible. As he hunts for revenge, he faces dangers and uncovers dark truths, determined to clear his name and make the true culprits pay for their actions.

programme.title: Pistol for a Hundred Coffins
programme.desc: A Civil War veteran swears revenge when he returns home to find his family killed by a local gang.

programme.title: A Town Called Hell
programme.desc: A group of Mexican revolutionaries murders a town priest and a number of his christian followers. Ten years later, a widow arrives in town intent to take revenge from her husband's killers.

programme.title: Brother Outlaw
programme.desc: A man is falsely charged with bank robbery, prompting his brother to break him out of prison.

programme.title: The Brute and the Beast
programme.desc: In 1866 Texas, prospector Tom Corbett returns to Laramie Town to find it terrorized by gangster Jason Scott and his psychotic son Junior. With his drunken brother Jeff and maid Mercedes, Tom must rally allies to overthrow the Scotts and restore peace.

programme.title: Trinity and Sartana Are Coming
programme.desc: Sartana and Trinity set out on a grudging relationship hell bent for gold and comic brawls.

programme.title: Django Meets Sartana
programme.desc: The small desert town of Black City is held in a reign of terror by a nasty gang of criminals lead by the ruthless Bud Willer.

programme.title: Cry Blood Apache
programme.desc: Gang of sadistic cowboys let nothing stand in their way in their search for gold.

programme.title: Flaming Frontier
programme.desc: Old Surehand and his loyal companion Old Wabble hunt a ruthless killer known as “The General,” who murdered Surehand’s brother. Their quest draws them into growing tensions between settlers and the Comanches. With the help of his blood brother Winnetou, Old Surehand must face both personal vengeance and the threat of war.

programme.title: Degueyo
programme.desc: When Ramon's bandits storm Danger City for rumored treasure, they slaughter or capture the men, leaving only women and children to face a ruthless "Deguello" if the money isn’t found. Four determined men, already hunting Ramon, join forces to help the town defend itself.

programme.title: Two Crosses at Danger Pass
programme.desc: Judy and Alex are the only two survivors of a punitive mission ordered by the rich and ruthless Moran.... The girl becomes his maid and the boy is adopted by a Quaker family. Alex, despite the philosophy of forgiveness he has been taught, plans to take revenge.

programme.title: Companeros!
programme.desc: A Swedish arms dealer and a Mexican peon team up to rescue the intellectual leader of the Revolutionary cause, while taking part in numerous misadventures along the way.

programme.title: Trinity in Eldorado
programme.desc: Con artists Jonathan and Sebastian roam the West seeking easy riches. When magic elixirs and card tricks fail, they target the eccentric Eldorado. Recruiting Ringo Jones and enlisting Eldorado’s niece Juanita, they plot the heist - but with so much at stake, can trust survive among them?

programme.title: Buddy Goes West
programme.desc: Two outlaws, "The Doctor" and the Indian Girolamo, help a village fight a gang and a corrupt sheriff who has discovered gold beneath the town.

programme.title: The Desperado Trail
programme.desc: After the Civil War, renegade Rollins and his gang stir conflict between settlers and Native Americans. Apache chief Winnetou and his friend Old Shatterhand try to preserve peace, but Winnetou is framed for the murder of Chief White Buffalo’s son using his own knife. Old Shatterhand must uncover the truth and clear his friend’s name.

programme.title: Two Brothers in Trinity
programme.desc: After inheriting a land plot in a dusty place called Trinity, the antagonistic half-brothers, Lester and Jesse, reunite to pursue different aspirations, only to find themselves neck-deep in trouble. Will they ever fulfil their dreams?

programme.title: A Few Bullets More
programme.desc: Billy starts as an innocent outlaw protecting his mother but soon becomes a ruthless killer. When love gives him hope for change, Pat Garrett, a fatherly friend, helps him try to turn his life around. Yet fate drags Billy back into violence, and Garrett is ultimately credited with his death.

programme.title: Pilotos del Ártico (Ice Pilots)
programme.desc: La Navidad está a la vuelta de la esquina, pero la comida y el correo cruciales de Buffalo se detienen. El crujiente mecánico Chuck debe intentar un cambio de motor con las manos desnudas en menos 30, y la presión de los clientes y compañeros de trabajo empuja al gerente de carga Kelly.

programme.title: Pilotos del Ártico (Ice Pilots)
programme.desc: Una racha de mala suerte hace que el 66 grados cumpleaños del piloto en jefe Arnie huya del infierno y amenaza con estropear su sorpresa de cumpleaños traviesa. El ayudante de rampa Jeremy está desesperado por ascender en los rangos, pero una novata podría arrojar una llave en sus planes, después de que la tripulación trabaja toda la noche para convertir el DC-4 en un tanque de gas volador.

programme.title: Pilotos del Ártico (Ice Pilots)
programme.desc: Cuando una falla de energía deja a Rankin Inlet expuesto a los elementos brutales del norte, el capitán Justin corre para entregar un generador de emergencia. El ayudante de rampa Jeremy intenta adelantarse a la compañera de trabajo Audrey entrenando a un nuevo empleado de la India para reemplazarlo. Y cuando la recesión pisa los talones de Joe, intenta negociar un acuerdo de $ 7 millones.

programme.title: Pilotos del Ártico (Ice Pilots)
programme.desc: El mecánico Cory corre contra el reloj para convertir dos bombas de agua de corto alcance en aviones transatlánticos para el viaje épico a Turquía. Depende del ingeniero Adam sacar a la tripulación del C-46 de un atasco en una pista de aterrizaje remota en menos 40. Y cuando el capitán Devan y el copiloto Scott encuentran la amenaza de la cizalladura del viento en el famoso Bear Rock.

programme.title: Pilotos del Ártico (Ice Pilots)

La tarea de Justin es trasladar a un británico impaciente, su perro y todas sus posesiones mundanas a un remoto puesto avanzado del norte, pero el clima no está cooperando.

programme.title: Pilotos del Ártico (Ice Pilots)

Cuando los fuertes vientos brinden la ventana meteorológica tan esperada.

programme.title: Pilotos del Ártico (Ice Pilots)

programme.title: The Military Tech Show S1 - "Terrorist Threats, Sea Wasp Robot, Combat Medics"
programme.desc: With an increasing terrorist threat to ports and shipping, the Swedish manufacturer SAAB has developed the Sea Wasp, an under-water robot for detecting explosive devices.

programme.title: The Military Tech Show S1 - "Warrior Vehicles, British Special Forces"
programme.desc: We're in Scotland for Unmanned Warrior, the key international military exercise using unmanned underwater, surface and airborne vehicles. We visit the Italian textile manufacturer who's kitting from a revolutionary new form of wool.

programme.title: Battle Factory S1 - "An Amphibious Armoured Vehicle, a Bomb Robot, and a Life Raft"
programme.desc: When a steel plated hull is fitted with controls on the inside and tracks on the outside, it’ll become the Viking BVS10 –an armoured amphibious personnel carrier that can get troops in and out of any combat zone, even if it has to go through snow, sand, or water to get there.

programme.title: Battle Factory S1 - "A Helmet, a Zippo, a Fuel Bladder, and a Simulated IED"
programme.desc: When a series of delicate snowflake shaped sheets of Aramid are pressed together, they’ll form a piece of headgear that’s comfortable enough to wear to war, and tough enough to take a bullet.

programme.title: Battle Factory S1 - "A Pistol, a Firetruck, a Ghillie Suit, and an Armored Fighting Vehicle"
programme.desc: At the Cabot factory in Pennsylvania, USA, a block of steel will be transformed by innovation and artistry into the ultimate update of an American classic. The 1911 did tours of duty in both world wars and Vietnam, and is still prized today by collectors and enthusiasts.

programme.title: Dictators' Hideouts S1 - "Hitler's Last Secret"
programme.desc: Thanks to secret, recently discovered microfilm, Hitler's last secret is revealed: a sprawling underground headquarters at Książ Castle.

programme.title: Dictators' Hideouts S1 - "Mussolini's Underground Refuge"
programme.desc: 50 km north of Rome lies the greatest hideout in fascist Italy’s history: The Monte Soratte Bunker, with security features even a Bond villain could only dream of.

programme.title: Dictators' Hideouts S1 - "Hoxha's Bunker Madness"
programme.desc: Paranoid and isolated, Albanian dictator Enver Hoxha establishes his bunkerization project, which would result in the construction of more than 170,000 bunkers.

programme.title: Dictators' Hideouts S1 - "Stalin's Atomic Bunker"
programme.desc: Infamous for the bunkers constructed during World War II and throughout the Cold War, Stalin’s hideouts have maintained a shroud of secrecy for decades, and are now seen for the first time.

programme.title: Breaking Limits S1 - "Speedskating"
programme.desc: Speed skater Beorn Nijenhuis and presenter Julien Kang visit laboratories to ask how does technology help to make the difference between silver and gold?

programme.title: Breaking Limits S1 - "Snowboarding"
programme.desc: How do innovators and athletes work together to beat the competition on the slope and the half pipe?

programme.title: Bright Now S1 - "Apocalypse 101"
programme.desc: Could you find a way to survive in a post-apocalyptic world? Astrobiologist and author Lewis Dartnell explores what it would take to stay alive following a global cataclysm, and what knowledge we would need to rebuild civilization as we know it.

programme.title: Earth's Eternal Wonders S1 - "Iceland: The Dane on the Volcano"
programme.desc: CGI cracks open Iceland's surface to reveal two continents tearing apart and a constant flow of underground magma fueling the island's growth.

programme.title: Earth's Eternal Wonders S1 - "Halong Bay - The island labyrinth of the dragon bay"
programme.desc: Advanced graphics turn back time to show how rising post-ice age sea levels flooded a cliff-lined valley to create Vietnam's unique karst maze.

programme.title: Earth's Eternal Wonders S1 - "Grand Canyon: The Window Into the Earths History"
programme.desc: Scientists rappel deep into the canyon to read geological layers, tracing its shifts from a primeval mountain range and desert into a giant gorge.

programme.title: Earth's Eternal Wonders S2 - "East African Rift Valley"
programme.desc: Journey to Ethiopia’s Afar Triangle, where Africa is splitting apart and scientists uncover clues to Earth’s history and our own origins.

programme.title: Oddly Satisfying Science S1 - "Science on Fire"
programme.desc: This week's experiments investigate how you can burn metal using only a 9 volt battery, what fire can teach us about calories, and why a little bit of sodium can cause a gigantic explosion.

programme.title: Oddly Satisfying Science S1 - "Invisible Impacts"
programme.desc: This week's experiments explore the resonant frequencies of bridges and human bodies, the mind boggling world of quantum levitation, and how to whip up the conditions to recreate nature's scariest cyclone: a fire tornado.

programme.title: Oddly Satisfying Science S1 - "Water, Water Everywhere"
programme.desc: In this week's experiments we discover how water can start a fire, transform breakfast cereal into a magnetic field detector, and even change the way you visualize the world around you.

programme.title: Oddly Satisfying Science S1 - "Magnificent Mixtures"
programme.desc: In this week's experiments we mix up some fireworks made from tin foil, whip up a stinky polymer, and try out an alchemy staple - turning lead into gold.

programme.title: Oddly Satisfying Science S1 - "Up and Atom"
programme.desc: This week's experiments blow open the science behind creating a glowing pickle, how forensic teams extract DNA, and how acids can transform simple household items to their core.

programme.title: The Demolition Man S1 - "Manchester"
programme.desc: A bridge in Manchester gets demolished.

programme.title: The Demolition Man S1 - "Louisiana"
programme.desc: Explosive demolition of the O. K. Allen Bridge.

programme.title: The Demolition Man S1 - "Lewisham"
programme.desc: A council flat in Lewisham must come down quickly and without harming the local residents’ flats situated only metres away.

programme.title: The Demolition Man S1 - "Paris"
programme.desc: Two high-rises in Meaux have to be demolished without endangering the surrounding people and buildings.

programme.title: Survival Science S1 - "Surviving a Bear Attack"
programme.desc: Nick and Laura create kick-ass tests to explore the immense power and startling speed of grizzly bears. They use Hollywood stunt tools to experience an attack. Then try to recreate a “miracle” arrow shot that saved a man from being killed by a bear.

programme.title: Survival Science S1 - "Surviving Treestand Accidents"
programme.desc: In this exciting episode we’ll find out the reasons why tree stand accidents happen and how we can prevent them. Cool science mixed with dynamic experiments send our hosts, our stunt team and our special crash test dummies plummeting to the ground.

programme.title: Survival Science S1 - "Sniper Attack"
programme.desc: Military snipers are trained in a variety of skills: detection, stalking, camouflage, infiltration, special reconnaissance and target acquisition. Bottom line, a ton of cool shooting and science for Nick and Laura to explore!

programme.title: Survival Science S1 - "Surviving a Lightning Strike"
programme.desc: Laura and Nick travel to a state-of-the-art Direct Effects Lightning Test Lab. With some “explosive” experiments, they’ll determine the power lightning and how it behaves? And they’ll find out how can hunters and fishermen best protect themselves?

programme.title: Engineering the Future S1 - "Fusion"
programme.desc: It is the greatest technological challenge ever undertaken by humankind. The quest to produce the ultimate energy solution... fusion.

programme.title: Engineering the Future S1 - "Tidal"
programme.desc: The power of the ocean's tides is the last great untapped energy source on Earth. Teams of engineers race to perfect the technology to harness the vast flowers of water.

programme.title: Engineering the Future S1 - "Maritime"
programme.desc: Shipping companies and engineers are creating new machines to make their industry greener using a resource that has moved man across oceans for thousands of years... winds.

programme.title: Engineering Reborn S1 - "Tate Modern, TWA Hotel, Tropical Island Resort"
programme.desc: A power station, airport terminal, and airship hangar undergo dramatic structural revamps into world-class facilities.

programme.title: Engineering Reborn S1 - "St. Louis Aquarium, Museum of African Art, Television Centre"
programme.desc: A historic train station, grain silos, and broadcasting headquarters are transformed into state-of-the-art hubs.

programme.title: Engineering Reborn S1 - "Maritime Museum, Coal Drops Yard, Peace Bunker"
programme.desc: A dry dock, coal depot, and Cold War tank shelter are reimagined into striking contemporary public spaces.

programme.title: Building to the Sky S1 - "Monuments and Money 1972 - 1997"
programme.desc: Engineering breakthroughs like bundled-tube systems support massive towers until financial shifts push high-rise development toward Asia.

programme.title: The Lightbulb Moment S1 - "FLORIDA"
programme.desc: Florida wasn’t always the Sunshine State. In the 1920s, an army of real estate boosters set out to redefine Florida from an economic backwater to a vacation destination, sparking a land boom–and bust–the likes of which America had never seen before.

programme.title: The Lightbulb Moment S1 - "MAUVE"
programme.desc: In 1856, a chemistry student accidentally created a strange substance with a rich purple hue -- the world’s first synthetic dye. In just a few years, ‘Mauve’ would take over the fashion industry and enable stunning advances in medicine.

programme.title: Xploration Outer Space S4 - "Space Myths"
programme.desc: Host Emily Calandrelli speaks to two experts who debunk many of the myths about outer space.

programme.title: Xploration Outer Space S4 - "Lost in Space"
programme.desc: There have been a few occasions when spacecraft have been lost in space. Host Emily Calandrelli looks at several of these adventures.

programme.title: Xploration Outer Space S4 - "Canadian Space Agency"
programme.desc: Host Emily Calandrelli visits the Canadian Space Center in Quebec, and examines their exceptional expertise in robotics, which includes the famous Canadarm.

programme.title: Hollywood Weapons: Fact or Fiction? S4 - "MacSchappert"
programme.desc: What can Terry do with just a paperclip? Probably nothing, but Larry and Terry will test several scenes from MacGyver, including making an exploding pen, shooting a spear out of a telescope, and they will enlist the help of Andre Ellingson’s Special Effects team to see if they can turn a car muffler into a bazooka!

programme.title: Hollywood Weapons: Fact or Fiction? S5 - "Terry's Lethal Weapon"
programme.desc: Can a Surfboard act as a projectile going through a car windshield and killing the bad guy?Can a 9mm bullet go through a bulldozer bucket to stop the driver?And will a AK47 be able to fire under water?

programme.title: Hollywood Weapons: Fact or Fiction? S5 - "Jean Claude Van Schappert"
programme.desc: Terry enters the world of Slow-Mo and explosions trying to imitate Jean Claude in Hart Target. Terry and Larry will be testing 5 scenes from the Hard Target films. One of which will make you never look through a peep hole again!

programme.title: Past, Present, Future S1 - "...of Food"
programme.desc: Large factory farms produce food for the masses with one caveat; they’re terrible for the environment. In an attempt to remedy this, chefs and scientists are working together to create a future where what we eat is as sustainable as it is delicious.

programme.title: Journey to Planet Earth S2 - "Hot Zones"
programme.desc: Examines how recent trends in globalization and the altering of ecosystems have led to dramatic increases in the spread of infectious diseases.

programme.title: Journey to Planet Earth S2 - "Seas of Grass"
programme.desc: Shows the devastating environmental, political, and economic effects of the degradation of the world's grasslands.

programme.title: Journey to Planet Earth S2 - "On the Brink"
programme.desc: Considers how environmental pressures can lead to terrorism and regional conflict.

programme.title: Secrets of the Brain S1 - "Time"
programme.desc: Jack meets a woman who has lost all sense of time and reveals how time can be elastic.

programme.title: Secrets of the Brain S1 - "The Senses"
programme.desc: Jack meets people with synaesthesia and experiences multisensory gastronomy.

programme.title: Secrets of the Brain S1 - "Pain & Fear"
programme.desc: Wim Hof teaches Jack how to control his pain and plunge into the ice cold sea.

programme.title: Secrets of the Brain S1 - "Creativity"
programme.desc: Jack meets a man with Sudden Artistic Output syndrome and unleashes his creativity.

programme.title: Extremes S1 - "Largest Animals, Human Bodies and Football"
programme.desc: In this episode of Extremes, we will be exploring the largest animals, extreme facts about the human body and record breaking extremes in football and the field of music.

programme.title: Power & S3 - "MMA - Nick Hein"
programme.desc: Nick Hein is a professional Mixed Martial Artist from Cologne and signed with the UFC. His ultimate goal is to become MMA world champion.

programme.title: Power & S3 - "Extreme Martial Arts – Shaina West"
programme.desc: Shaina West taught herself martial arts by watching Youtube recovering from a motorcycle accident. The videos she posted went viral and ‘The Samurider’ was born.

programme.title: Power & S3 - "Karate – James Pankiewicz"
programme.desc: Englishman and karateka James Pankiewicz came to Okinawa, the birthplace of Karate, for his wife and to open a Dojo and the immensely popular Dojo Bar.

programme.title: Power & S3 - "Bokator – Tharot Sam"
programme.desc: Tharoth Sam, 26, is the first female fighter in Cambodian Bokator. She is also an MMA fighter and became a movie star starring in the big screen blockbuster, Jailbreak.

programme.title: Around the World in 80 Tricks S1 - "Paris & Barcelona"
programme.desc: Bones introduce his trademark trickery to people in Paris and Barcelona, performing mind reading and an attempt to escape a straitjacket while breakdancing.

programme.title: Around the World in 80 Tricks S1 - "London"
programme.desc: In this episode Bones is back in his home city, London where he stuns locals with his mind reading, card trickery and disappearing skills.

programme.title: Around the World in 80 Tricks S1 - "South Korea - Night"
programme.desc: Bones is in Seoul, South Korea. He explores the city by night and performs a mixture of magic tricks, including a vanishing trick, coin tricks and card tricks.

programme.title: Around the World in 80 Tricks S1 - "South Korea - Traditional"
programme.desc: In this episode Bones is in South Korea, where he visits Taekwondo group, the K Tigers, a tarot card reader and reveals the secret to the perfect card shuffle.

programme.title: Xploration DIY Sci S5 - "Garage Science"
programme.desc: Host Steve Spangler and his sidekick Higginsworth explore science experiments you can do in your own garage.

programme.title: Xploration DIY Sci S5 - "Art Science"
programme.desc: Host Steve Spangler and his sidekick Higginsworth explore new ways to create art, using science.

programme.title: Xploration DIY Sci S5 - "Classroom: Impossible"
programme.desc: Fourth grade teacher Sandra Sanchez has a problem – her class is a year behind in science after a season of virtual-only teaching.

programme.title: Xploration DIY Sci S5 - "Museum Of Science, Boston #1"
programme.desc: Host Steve Spangler and his sidekick Higginsworth explore the Museum of Science, Boston, for new do-it-yourself science tricks and experiments.

programme.title: Strip The City S2 - "Tokyo"
programme.desc: Experts strip away Tokyo to show the seismic engineering, massive storm drains, and advanced shock absorbers keeping this earthquake-prone city safe.

programme.title: Strip The City S2 - "New Orleans"
programme.desc: The defenses of New Orleans are stripped back to expose the massive pumps, levees, and wetlands engineered to hold back Mississippi and Gulf storms.

programme.title: The New Frontier S4 - "Hyabusa2"
programme.desc: The Japanese Asteroid sample return mission has reached its target and is surveying the space rock ready to dip down and take a sample. The return of asteroid material to Earth will aid scientists in the evolving asteroid planetary defense systems.

programme.title: The New Frontier S4 - "Eyes to the Heavens"
programme.desc: Two new space telescopes are in orbit and completing their shakedown; Gaia and TESS they too will be joined by the James Webb Telescope. Together they will be opening up a whole new vista into time and space.

programme.title: The New Frontier S4 - "Martian Attractions"
programme.desc: The Latest in Martian exploration from orbit and on the ground, new sources of water and planetary dust storms are a few of the stories unfolding on to the Red Planet.

programme.title: The New Frontier S4 - "Cubesat"
programme.desc: Cubesats the tiny Satellites are growing in main stream popularity, they have even been sent to Mars with the Insight Mission.

programme.title: Xploration Earth 2050 S2 - "The Animal Kingdom Meets Future Tech"
programme.desc: Host Chuck Pell goes to abandoned areas of Detroit where dog lovers are tracking thousands of strays… with drones.

programme.title: Xploration Earth 2050 S2 - "The Future Of Learning"
programme.desc: Host Chuck Pell shows us a place that’s taking a hands-on approach to learning with robotic creatures.

programme.title: Xploration Earth 2050 S2 - "Transforming How Things Are Made"
programme.desc: Host Chuck Pell will see how industrial diamonds are transforming manufacturing.

programme.title: Strip The Cosmos S1 - "Mars"
programme.desc: Beneath the red dust, CGI peels away Martian volcanoes and ice to reveal a once-Earth-like world and the challenges of future human missions.

programme.title: Strip The Cosmos S1 - "The Sun"
programme.desc: By stripping away the Sun's boiling plasma layers, this CGI study reveals the nuclear core that fuels our world while tracking lethal solar storms.

programme.title: Xploration Outer Space S4 - "Fun with the Sun"
programme.desc: Host Emily Calandrelli looks at NASA’s next mission to send a spacecraft that will “touch” the sun.

programme.title: Xploration Outer Space S4 - "Space Firsts"
programme.desc: Host Emily Calandrelli interviews several pioneers of space and discovers the determination and courage required to become the “first”.

programme.title: Xploration Outer Space S4 - "Teaming up with NASA"
programme.desc: Host Emily Calandrelli visits the Sierra Nevada Corporation, which is building a spacecraft that can deliver cargo to and from the International Space Station.

programme.title: Xploration Outer Space S4 - "Students of Space"
programme.desc: Host Emily Calandrelli looks at students who are becoming involved with space exploration.

programme.title: The New Frontier S4 - "Proving Einstein"
programme.desc: Some of the proof of Einstein’s theories had long been elusive, beyond the capabilities of technology, until now. It appears that Einstein is once again triumphant with the latest in deep space observations.

programme.title: The New Frontier S4 - "Where Are All the Aliens?"
programme.desc: We’re looking hard, but the numbers aren’t stacking up, is life on other planets that hard to find? Even signals from an advanced race elude us. Maybe we really are alone in our neck of the galaxy!

programme.title: The New Frontier S5 - "Star Light, Star Bright"
programme.desc: The two current science missions to our star; the sun have made great leaps forward in the science of how stars work, how they generate solar winds and how they affect their orbiting planets. This lets us look at other stars with great understanding.

programme.title: The New Frontier S5 - "Moon Shine"
programme.desc: The International drive to return to the Moon is gathering pace. We look at what resources scientists and engineers are looking to extract from Lunar regolith and Martian soil.

programme.title: Bright Now S1 - "The Wright Brothers: Bravery"
programme.desc: Just over 100 years ago, a pair of brothers looked at the sky and changed the world. They designed, built and flew the most ridiculous of inventions. How did two bicycle mechanics manage to succeed where the others had failed?

programme.title: Women Make Science S1 - "Kyrgyzstan’s Space School"
programme.desc: In a country where girls are often kidnapped and forced to marry, a defiant all-girls space-tech school are building Kyrgyzstan’s first satellite.

programme.title: Women Make Science S1 - "Ecuador’s Hidden Treasure"
programme.desc: Three women scientists take on Ecuador’s endangered spider monkeys and empower indigenous women, in a scientific area usually dominated by men.

programme.title: Women Make Science S1 - "From The Lab To The Field"
programme.desc: From the laboratory to Africa, Dr Sheila Ochugboju takes her scientific knowledge to Kenya turning parasitic problems into scientific solutions.

programme.title: Women Make Science S1 - "Dolphin Sanctuary"
programme.desc: Anastasia Miliou and her team of women scientist are building a sanctuary in Greece for dolphins released from captivity, the first of its kind.

programme.title: Secrets of the Factories S1 - "Secrets of McVitie's Biscuits"
programme.desc: The McVitie's factory in Carlisle, Cumbria, opens its doors to reveal how millions of the nation's favourite biscuits are made, 24 hours a day, in one of Britain's biggest factories and oldest biscuit factory in the world.

programme.title: Secrets of the Factories S1 - "Secrets of the Heinz Factory"
programme.desc: From making fresh spaghetti and mixing the top-secret ingredients for sauce, to giant automated cranes and the latest robots, join today’s Heinz factory workers alongside tomorrow’s machines, making cans of household favourites.

programme.title: Secrets of the Factories S1 - "Secrets of Mr. Kipling Cakes"
programme.desc: Uncover the secrets of what it takes to make up to 5 million cakes a day, including French Fancies, Angel Slices and Bramley Apple Pies. Meet the engineers who keep the machines running 24/7, the workers making all the cakes, and the operators who spend their days with state-of-the-art robots.

programme.title: Secrets of the Factories S1 - "Secrets of Kellogg's Cereals"
programme.desc: In Kellogg’s first factory in Europe, built in the 1930s in Trafford Park, Manchester, we meet the people who flake the corn and puff the rice, the tasters who test, and the robots and hi-tech machines that help keep the boxes rolling out day and night.

programme.title: Skuld: A Look into the Future S1 - "World Ex"
programme.desc: Get excited with a digital car competition that pits teams from around the world against each other on digital race tracks, with the goal of protecting the environment.

programme.title: Skuld: A Look into the Future S1 - "Energy Globe World Award 20th"
programme.desc: Follow behind the scenes of awards ceremony for sustainability projects that can change the world.

programme.title: Skuld: A Look into the Future S1 - "10 Genius Inventions – Part 1"
programme.desc: Learn about an award ceremony for sustainability projects that can change the world.

programme.title: Skuld: A Look into the Future S1 - "10 Genius Inventions – Part 2"
programme.desc: Learn about an award ceremony for sustainability projects that can change the world.

programme.title: Digits S1 - "Connecting to the Future"
programme.desc: Muller escorts viewers to the physical heart of the Internet, revealing the very first message sent by UCLA professor Leonard Kleinrock, and demonstrating how Internet co-creators Vint Cerf and Bob Kahn devised a common protocol language.

programme.title: Digits S1 - "Man vs. Machine"
programme.desc: Get a sneak peek into how the Internet of Things will soon dominate daily life. As Edward Snowden provocatively points out, “TV is a medium that you watch. The Internet is a medium that watches you as you watch it.”.

programme.title: Digits S1 - "Guardians of the Web"
programme.desc: Explore how our reliance on the web creates vulnerability to everything from cyber theft to an Internet system failure. Muller introduces viewers to “white hat” hackers, the U.S. Secret Service’s cybercrime division and even West Point soldiers.

programme.title: The World of Bridges S1 - "India"
programme.desc: One of the most impressive steel bridges in the world can be found in Calcutta: the Howrah Bridge. Its predecessor is the Forth Bridge across the Firth of Forth, near the Scottish capital of Edinburgh.

programme.title: The World of Bridges S1 - "Zimbabwe"
programme.desc: The Great Seto Bridge in Japan and the Victoria Falls Bridge in Zimbabwe have more than one thing in common: they were built on dreams and are the only train connections between the two regions.

programme.title: Health Explored S2 - "Sands of Time Part 1"
programme.desc: From environmental health to physical health, discover what coastal life is like in Morocco before heading inland to the desert.

programme.title: Health Explored S2 - "Sands of Time Part 2"
programme.desc: Trek into the Sahara to camp and visit the nomads, to learn how climate change is impacting life in the desert and why time should be valued.

programme.title: Health Explored S2 - "Pura Vida Part 1"
programme.desc: "Pura Vida" is a popular saying in Costa Rica, often translated as "pure life" or "simple life." We learn from centenarians from the Blue Zone why we should live a pure life.

programme.title: Health Explored S2 - "Pura Vida Part 2"
programme.desc: We learn about conservation in Costa Rica from reforestation projects, to sustainable fishing and endangered turtle rescue.

programme.title: Rethink S1 - "Is a telescope a time machine?"
programme.desc: In a world where nothing is what it seems, we explore tricks using sleight of hand. Play games with a water bottle, take a look at the Dunning Kruger effect and answer the question; Is a telescope a time machine?

programme.title: Rethink S1 - "The Leidenfrost Effect"
programme.desc: In a world where nothing is what it seems, let’s play games with colour changing milk. Learn about chroma keys in video editing and do some mental math gymnastics. We’ll also explore the Leidenfrost effect and take a look at rethinker Linwood G Dunn.

programme.title: Orphans of the Wild S1 - "The Big Relocate"
programme.desc: Three adult lions and two wild leopards must swap enclosures, a dangerous exercise and if things can go wrong, they will.

programme.title: Orphans of the Wild S1 - "Big Cats & Baby Baboons"
programme.desc: Umbili and Shakira, the leopard cubs, are becoming a real threat to Zacheo’s safety and they must be moved, on a more comical note the baby baboons are moved in with the juveniles.

programme.title: Orphans of the Wild S1 - "New-born"
programme.desc: It’s a year later, and things have changed – Marlice and Rudie have a new baby boy – and he needs to be introduced to the animals.

programme.title: Orphans of the Wild S1 - "New Beginning’s and Sad Endings"
programme.desc: Even at a Wildlife sanctuary poaching can rear it’s ugly head and quick action needs to be taken.

programme.title: NCIS: New Orleans
programme.desc: A Navy SEAL candidate is murdered weeks before his graduation; Wade seeks Pride's help when her adopted son announces his plan to join the Navy.

programme.title: NCIS: New Orleans

programme.title: Mission to the Moon
programme.desc: In the international race to the moon, the Norwegian mission is led by brilliant inventor Reodor from the village of Flaklypa. With Louis the Magpie as the brave astronaut, what could possibly go wrong? Quite a bit, actually – on the daring mission, secret passengers are discovered, hidden agendas are revealed, and nothing seems to work out the way it was planned. Louis and his friend Luca the Hedgehog are in for some surprises on their trip to the moon. The third film in the stop-motion trilogy featuring the beloved characters from the Flaklypa universe.

programme.title: Spy Cat
programme.desc: Four crazy anti-heroes, one pawsome adventure. Join special-agent Marnie and her friends as they team up and fight crime. Spoiled and innocent, chubby house cat Marnie lives a comfortable and pampered life in the Sunshine household. She has never ventured outside the family home and only knows about the real world through her favourite detective, crime TV-shows.

programme.title: 100% Wolf : Legend of the Moonstone
programme.desc: Freddy Lupin manages to convince the pack elders to let him sit Howlington Academy’s entrance test. Freddy must use all his poodle wits- and his best friend Batty’s help!- to win a place at the historically wolf-only academy.

programme.title: 100% Wolf : Legend of the Moonstone
programme.desc: It’s the first day of school, and Freddy immediately comes into conflict with bully Ivan, who blackmails him into stealing the sacred moonstone! But when Batty is exposed to the moonstone, she’s turned into a human girl!

programme.title: 100% Wolf : Legend of the Moonstone
programme.desc: Freddy attempts to teach Batty how to be human, while searching for a cure for her new form. A class assignment to capture the mysterious ‘Golden Horn’ and prove who the ‘alpha’ wolf is goes awry when a wilderwolf attacks!

programme.title: 100% Wolf : Legend of the Moonstone
programme.desc: Freddy becomes convinced that there’s a wilderwolf at Howlington, and launches a daring investigation to prove that it’s the school accountant, Mr Sminch. Howlington gets a new teacher, the super cool and charming Ric Rawls.

programme.title: 100% Wolf : Legend of the Moonstone
programme.desc: The kids are struck down by a flea infestation, and Freddy and Batty are tasked with tracking down the mysterious Doog, keeper of the Fleaminator, the most powerful flea treatment known to dog, before they’re all expelled!

programme.title: 100% Wolf : Legend of the Moonstone
programme.desc: The kids head out on their first excursion to Night Patrol HQ. Freddy gets pulled into Scarlet’s world as she gets closer to the truth about werewolves and the two bond when they get stuck in the forest while tracking a wolf.

programme.title: 100% Wolf : Legend of the Moonstone
programme.desc: It’s Howloween, and Howlington is on lockdown. But when the students stage a play that goes wrong and the lockdown is disrupted, it will be up to the kids to save the grown-ups from themselves - including Principal Pincus!

programme.title: 100% Wolf : Legend of the Moonstone
programme.desc: Freddy and Ivan have failed their runes exam and have to do it over - or they won’t be allowed to attend the Doom Wolves concert. But their study session ends up putting themselves, and the Doom Wolves, in grave danger!

programme.title: Back to the Sea
programme.desc: When little fish Kevin is swept up in a net and taken from his home in the vast oceans to the small glass fish tank of a restaurant, he must find a way to escape and make his way back home.

programme.title: Racetime
programme.desc: Frankie and Sophie challenge newcomers Zac and Charlie to an epic sled race.

programme.title: Son of Bigfoot
programme.desc: A teenage boy journeys to find his missing father only to discover that he's actually Bigfoot.

programme.title: Ozzy
programme.desc: The lovable Ozzy’s pampered life is thrown into turmoil after his family drops him at Blue Creek before their vacation. Ozzy quickly learns that Blue Creek is a dog prison and he’ll need to rely on some new friends to help him break out and get back home.

programme.title: Stardog & Turbocat
programme.desc: A loyal dog and a vigilante cat embark on a space age voyage to find their way home.

programme.title: Rally Road Racers
programme.desc: A rookie race-car driver gets the opportunity to compete against the reigning champion. With help from a former driver, he must overcome treacherous terrain, rival racers and unexpected obstacles to prove he has what it takes.

programme.title: Cats
programme.desc: A cat named Blanket lives in the city with his son, Cape. One day, Cape decides to leave home and embarks on an adventure to find the legendary cat's paradise. To find his son, Blanket must overcome his fear and reconcile with his past.

programme.title: Tall Tales
programme.desc: When his beloved Queen bee Marguerite is kidnapped, vagabond cricket Apollo who has been framed for the crime, teams up with the other bugs to save the Queen and the entire kingdom.

programme.title: Luis and the Aliens
programme.desc: A boy at risk of being sent to boarding school by his Dad - and three aliens stranded due to watching too much TV - must help each other out.
